notes.title: Free game coming!
notes.notes:
In honor of the author's return to being an indie developer, this game will be available for free in the future. Additionally, he has plans to release another free game, possibly within three months. This picture will serve as a link to the new version of the game.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/923890/Yet_another_tower_defence/][img]https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/d/d2/Bianjing_city_gate.JPG[/img][/url]

notes.title: Major BUG repair
notes.notes:
Because the author accidentally deleted a line of code, the player would not automatically reset the blood volume, and then the monster could not move at the end of the line. It's now fixed to restart the steam update game.
Here I express my sincere apology, and encourage you to give a positive feedback to BUG, I see that it will be the first time to repair, thank you all!

notes.title: 重大Bug修复通知
notes.notes:
由于作者在改动时不小心删掉了一行代码，导致玩家血量不会自动重置，然后怪物就会卡在终点不能动。
在此我表示最真挚的歉意，并鼓励大家积极反馈BUG，我看到一定会第一时间修复，谢谢大家！
